note: [LLM critic, high conf] The AI charges a 4-wound Mek at 8% odds. The positive terms (ch_damage 40, ch_can_wipe 5, ch_can_halve 3, ch_character 2) use full melee damage and ignore that the charge usually fails. This pushes a 0.47 score over the threshold. Fix: Multiply all payoff terms by charge_probability. Set a hard floor of about 25 to 30% chance before the aggression and tempo bonuses can apply. Add a penalty for leaving a held objective, and a check on whether a unit that cannot reach is better off shooting.
